name: NestJS Observe
description: Queries NestJS app traces, errors, slow operations, and release regressions from coding agents through NestJS Observe's hosted MCP server.

skills.name: Find Regressions
skills.description: Finds regressions by comparing error rate and latency on either side of each release and names the release that made things worse.

skills.name: Diff Release
skills.description: Shows what a release changed in the code, such as an N+1 query, a new outbound call, or a slower method.

skills.name: Get Trace
skills.description: Resolves a trace ID into its waterfall of executions and span trees across services, plus every log line emitted under it.

skills.name: Investigate Errors
skills.description: Lists a project's error groups and returns error details with the trace behind each failure, so agents can find the cause.

skills.name: Inspect Background Jobs
skills.description: Lists background jobs and returns job details and traces so agents can investigate failed or slow jobs in a NestJS app.
